userStories.title: Supabase data sync with offline queue and retry logic

Submit button disabled when email format is invalid

Error messages never expose internal Supabase error codes or stack traces

previousStories.notes: isEmailValid regex validation with inline error. sanitizeAuthError() maps all Supabase errors to friendly messages. Submit disabled when email invalid.

previousStories.title: Account deletion flow with data cleanup
previousStories.description: As a user, I want to delete my account and all associated data so I can exercise my right to data erasure (App Store requirement).
acceptanceCriteria: SettingsView shows a 'Delete Account' button in the Account section (destructive style)
Tapping 'Delete Account' shows a confirmation dialog explaining consequences
Confirmation requires typing 'DELETE' to proceed (prevents accidental deletion)
SettingsViewModel gains a deleteAccount() method that calls SupabaseService
SupabaseService gains a deleteAccount() method that: deletes all user data from all tables, then signs out
New edge function endpoint POST /delete-account that: validates JWT, deletes user data across all tables, deletes auth.users entry via service role
Success signs user out and shows confirmation message
Analytics event tracked for account_deleted
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: Delete Account in Settings. Requires typing DELETE to confirm. Server-side edge function deletes all data + auth user. Rate limited to 3 req/min.

previousStories.title: Biometric authentication (FaceID/TouchID) for app access
previousStories.description: As a user, I want to optionally lock the app with FaceID/TouchID so my tracked data stays private on shared devices.
acceptanceCriteria: New BiometricService singleton using LocalAuthentication framework
BiometricService exposes available biometric type (faceID, touchID, none)
Settings toggle 'Require FaceID/TouchID' in a new Security section
When enabled, app shows a lock screen on launch and returning from background
Lock screen has biometric prompt button and fallback to device passcode
Setting stored in UserDefaults (biometricLockEnabled)
ContentView checks biometric lock state before showing main content
NSFaceIDUsageDescription added to Info.plist

previousStories.notes: BiometricService singleton with FaceID/TouchID. Lock screen on background/launch. Security section in Settings with toggle. NSFaceIDUsageDescription in Info.plist.

previousStories.title: Input sanitization for user-generated content
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need all user-generated text fields sanitized before storage to prevent injection attacks and data corruption.
acceptanceCriteria: New InputSanitizer utility with sanitize(text:maxLength:) method
Strips leading/trailing whitespace and normalizes internal whitespace
Enforces character limits: tracker name (100), category name (50), notes (500)
Strips control characters and zero-width characters
AddTrackerView applies sanitization before saving
CompletionLog notes sanitized before saving
Character counter shown in text fields approaching the limit
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: InputSanitizer utility strips control/zero-width chars, normalizes whitespace, enforces length limits (100/50/500). Character counter in AddTrackerView. Applied to saveTracker.

previousStories.title: Secure token storage with Keychain
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need sensitive values (premium status, sync tokens) stored in Keychain instead of UserDefaults for security hardening.
acceptanceCriteria: New KeychainService utility wrapping Security framework for read/write/delete
RevenueCatService stores isPremium flag in Keychain (in addition to App Group UserDefaults for widget)
SupabaseService stores lastSyncTimestamp in Keychain
Existing UserDefaults values migrated to Keychain on first launch after update
Keychain items use kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock for background sync compatibility
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: KeychainService wrapper with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock. SupabaseService uses Keychain for lastSyncTimestamp. RevenueCat writes isPremium to both App Group UserDefaults and Keychain. Migration in LastLoggedApp.init().

previousStories.title: Auth session expiry handling and token refresh
previousStories.description: As a user, I want the app to gracefully handle expired sessions by re-authenticating instead of silently failing syncs.
acceptanceCriteria: SupabaseService detects 401/403 responses during sync and triggers re-authentication
On session expiry, a banner is shown: 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.'
Auth state listener set up via client.auth.onAuthStateChange to react to token refresh events
Sign-out is triggered automatically if token refresh fails
Sync operations abort early if session is expired (not just if isSignedIn is false)
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: Auth state listener via client.auth.authStateChanges. Session expired banner in HomeView with Sign In button. withRetry detects 401/403/JWT errors. Sync aborts early on expired session.

previousStories.title: Terms of Service agreement on sign up
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need users to agree to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy during sign up to ensure legal compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: AuthView shows a checkbox with links to Terms and Privacy Policy below the sign-up form
Sign-up button disabled until the checkbox is checked
Checkbox state tracked in AuthViewModel as hasAgreedToTerms
Links open in SFSafariViewController (in-app browser)
Agreement timestamp stored in user profile on the server (agreed_to_terms_at column on users table)

previousStories.notes: Checkbox with Terms/Privacy links in sign-up form. Sign-up button disabled until agreed. agreed_to_terms_at column in users table via migration. Timestamp stored on server via UserProfileRow.

previousStories.title: Server-side auth rate limiting via Supabase
previousStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side rate limiting on auth endpoints so that brute force attacks are blocked even if the client is bypassed.
acceptanceCriteria: New SQL migration creates auth_rate_limits table: ip_address, attempt_count, window_start, locked_until
New edge function POST /auth/check-rate-limit called before client auth attempts
Rate limit: 10 attempts per 15-minute window per IP
After limit exceeded, 5-minute lockout enforced
iOS app calls rate limit check before each auth attempt
Rate limit headers returned: X-Auth-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Auth-RateLimit-Reset
Typecheck passes
previousStories.notes: auth_rate_limits DB table. Edge function POST /auth/check-rate-limit with 10 attempts per 15min window, 5min lockout. iOS calls before each auth attempt. Rate limit headers returned.

previousStories.title: Webhook replay attack prevention

acceptanceCriteria: revenuecat-webhook.ts validates X-RevenueCat-Request-Timestamp header

Rejected replay attempts logged with structured logging including IP and timestamp

previousStories.notes: Validates X-RevenueCat-Request-Timestamp header. Rejects requests older than 5 minutes with 403. Logs rejected replay attempts with IP and timestamp.

acceptanceCriteria: Strict-Transport-Security header added: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload

Headers configured in Cloudflare _headers file or Astro middleware
